items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to writing hypotheses, operationalising variables, and the four sampling methods.

items.title: All in the Mind — BBC Radio 4
items.description: Claudia Hammond regularly explains how psychological research is designed — good context for understanding why sampling matters.

items.title: Introduction to Hypotheses | Research Methods | A-Level Psychology
items.description: Walks through null and alternative hypotheses with clear worked examples for AQA students.

items.title: A-Level Psychology (AQA): Sampling Techniques
items.description: Covers all four sampling methods — random, opportunity, systematic and stratified — as required by AQA GCSE Psychology.

items.title: Sampling — Research Methods [A-Level Psychology]
items.description: Detailed walkthrough of sampling strengths and weaknesses, useful for evaluation questions in the exam.

items.title: Three Identical Strangers
items.description: Shows the real consequences of a research study — the controversial Neubauer twin study — raising issues about participant selection and ethics.

items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology 8182 — Specification
items.description: Lists the exact hypothesis types and sampling methods assessed in Paper 2 Research Methods.

items.title: Khan Academy — Sampling Methods
items.description: Interactive review of random, systematic and stratified sampling with practice questions.
